description:
The black and white image depicts a close-up view of a single strawberry placed on a smooth, reflective surface, likely a metal or glass table. The strawberry is positioned slightly at an angle, with its leafy top clearly visible and facing upwards. The fruit appears fresh, with visible small seeds on its surface and a texture characteristic of ripe strawberries.

In the background, the image is out of focus, but it seems to show an indoor setting, possibly a kitchen or food preparation area. There is some equipment or containers placed around, contributing to the impression of a workspace. The lighting is soft, creating subtle shadows and highlights on the fruit and surface.

Given the context provided in Polish ("Owoc przed transportem w czasie"), which translates to "Fruit before transport in time," the photograph likely captures the strawberry just before it is packed or prepared for transportation, emphasizing its freshness and condition at that moment. The monochrome style adds a timeless, documentary-like quality to the image, highlighting the texture and details of the strawberry.
